stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Defender Strange dies fighting Wanda's demon, and his body falls into Strange's world, where Strange and Wong bury it. Later Strange dreamwalks into that body to stop Wanda and save America.
stages.whoA: Another Strange. He buries him, then dreamwalks into his body to stop Wanda.
stages.whoB: Another Strange, who buries him and later borrows his body.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Earth-838's Strange caused an incursion that destroyed a world, and his own Illuminati put him to death. When Strange arrives on their Earth, they put him on trial, fearing he is just as dangerous.
stages.whoA: Earth-838's Strange, whose crimes put him on trial.
stages.whoB: Another Strange, judged for what he did.
